tools.description: Read-only. Report how current Utilify's Texas utility plan data is, per utility type (electricity, gas, water, trash, internet, other). Returns aggregate counts and dates only: active plans, active providers, newest and oldest last-verified dates, the share of active plans inside and outside the sta

tools.name: get_concierge_offer
tools.description: Read the current concierge offer, including whether ordering is open, the price, the rush option and the current terms. It never returns a payment link. Ordering continues with accept_concierge_agreement and then order_concierge.

tools.name: accept_concierge_agreement
tools.description: Record that the buyer accepts the current concierge terms. Requires accept_agreement true and agreement_version from get_concierge_offer. Returns a short-lived single-use acceptance token. Does not return a payment link and does not store an order.

tools.name: order_concierge
tools.description: Store a concierge order after the buyer has accepted the current terms, then return the payment link for that order. Requires the acceptance token from accept_concierge_agreement. Rush service is refused when rush checkout is not configured, and the standard payment link is never used for a rush ord

tools.name: contact_utilify
tools.description: Send a message to the Utilify team on behalf of a person who has agreed to send it. Requires sender_approved true. Fields are name, email, an optional phone, an optional ZIP, a topic and a message. Returns a reference id. The team replies by email. Do not include a Social Security number, date of bi

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_utility_providers, get_provider_details, compare_providers, initiate_signup, check_signup_status · Private data: check_signup_status, get_data_freshness, accept_concierge_agreement, order_concierge, contact_utilify · Public sink: request_solar, get_data_freshness, order_concierge, contact_utilify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_utility_providers, get_provider_details, compare_providers, initiate_signup, check_signup_status · Private data: check_signup_status, get_data_freshness, accept_concierge_agreement, order_concierge, contact_utilify · Public sink: request_solar, get_data_freshness, order_concierge, contact_utilify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
